title: GateRejectReason
description: Why the owner rejected an intent; feeds the eval set (decided in #85, was #147). wrong_recipient: the right action addressed to the wrong person or place. wrong_content: what the intent says or does is wrong. wrong_tone: the content is right but the wording is not how the owner would put it. wrong_time: the action is right but not now, or scheduled for the wrong time. not_needed: nothing should have been proposed. other: none of these.
